confidence_scale.confirmed: Direct SDK type/signature evidence plus matching static mechanics or xrefs.
confidence_scale.high: Multiple independent static facts agree; one bounded semantic or ABI detail remains uncertain.
confidence_scale.medium: Mechanics are supported but type, ordering, or semantic role is incomplete.

identity_adjudication.conclusion: 0x00b21340 is the implementation entry used by the noun-consumer family and is the high-confidence implementation of Simulator::cGameNounManager::GetData. The SDK address 0x00b212d0 must not be treated as the same exact function entry without boundary repair: Ghidra contains a distinct 98-byte function at 0x00b212d0 and a distinct 202-byte function at 0x00b21340.

facts.observation: SDK XML and sdk_functions.tsv label this address Simulator::cGameNounManager::GetData; functions.tsv records a 98-byte function.
facts.xref_fact: The pinned xrefs contain one direct caller, 0x00b211e0 at 0x00b212cb.
facts.decomp_fact: The exported decompilation is boundary-contaminated and has inconsistent locals and callback shapes.

facts.observation: Ghidra records a separate 202-byte FUN_00b21340 with ECX this, five 32-bit stack arguments, RET 0x14, mNounMap access, and tGameDataVectorT<cGameData>* return mechanics.
facts.xref_fact: The pinned xrefs contain 318 direct-call edges from 254 unique caller functions.
facts.consumer_fact: The simulator noun accessors, 0x00b25ca0, 0x00b25f40, 0x00b25fe0, 0x00bf9820, and 0x00ba0080 call this entry.

steps.description: Simulator::cGameNounManager::Get at 0x00b3d400 returns the global cGameNounManager* without transferring ownership.
GetData at 0x00b21340 searches mNounMap (+0x98) by uint32 nounID through unsigned lower-bound helper 0x00e5c780.
On a missing/stale record, 0x00ba8420 is the only direct noun-path helper observed for insertion/default construction.
The manager-owned mNouns intrusive list is projected into the nounID-specific tGameDataVectorT using filter/add callbacks.
needsUpdate is cleared and the manager-owned map payload pointer is returned.

contradictions.claim_a: Earlier triage called the list node type unknown and recorded next +0x0c.

contradictions.claim_a: Older static summary says the function clears and returns a name buffer.

contradictions.claim_a: Prior records call 0x00ba8420 a mutation/insertion helper.
contradictions.claim_b: Its exact map template, signature, duplicate handling, and failure path are not persisted.
contradictions.resolution: Keep probable insertion/default-construction at medium confidence and do not implement its exact ABI.

contradictions.claim_a: Triage fan-in reports unique caller counts such as 254 and 239.

contradictions.resolution: Report both units; do not substitute edge count for caller-family count.
